arguments.prompt: Nine inventory icons for a moody adventure game, arranged as a 3 by 3 grid of equal square cells on one picture: in every cell one object centred and filling most of the cell, softly lit from the upper left, painterly realistic style, plain dark warm-grey cloth background with a faint vignette, the same background and the same scale in every cell (every object drawn at the same icon size, as large as the cell allows with a margin), no borders, frames or lines between the cells, nothing crossing a cell edge, exactly one object or one small group per cell, no text, letters, numbers or logos anywhere, not even on the objects. Everyday goods of a 1970s-80s Soviet seaside town, no real brands. Clothes are neatly folded or laid flat so they fit inside the cell. Row 1, left: a grey herringbone tweed flat cap with a short stiff peak, seen from the front at three quarters. Row 1, middle: a neatly folded yellow rubberised raincoat with a hood and big press studs, a matte sheen on the folds. Row 1, right: a neatly folded bottle-green zip windbreaker of thin crisp fabric with a stand-up collar and elastic cuffs. Row 2, left: a neatly folded heavy navy blue woollen winter coat with a dark fur collar and large buttons. Row 2, middle: a pointed felted wool banya cap of natural off-white felt with a rolled brim and a little loop at the tip. Row 2, right: a neatly folded thick white terry towel with a thin blue stripe across its end, soft loops visible. Row 3, left: a bath whisk of fresh birch twigs with glossy green leaves, its handle tied tight with rough twine, the leaves wet and glistening. Row 3, middle: a pair of Soviet leisure ice skates on white leather lace-up boots with polished steel blades, the laces tied together. Row 3, right: a small torn pink paper cinema ticket stub with a perforated torn edge and a faded violet stamp, no lettering.
